observations: The cross-repository repair-transfer unit ended truthfully as UNCERTAIN / NOT_EVALUABLE because one frozen source lacked the declared feature path.
Its exact lifecycle is durable, no Candidate or route was activated, and the upper and user objectives remain FAIL.
The next unit changes domain from code repair to cross-source public-data reconciliation and applies source-readiness before final precommit.

local_learn.observation: The failed repair-transfer trial shows that source readiness must precede immutable selection. A materially different cross-source reconciliation unit can test schema transfer, evidence attribution, negative controls, and replay without implying software-repair transfer, production readiness, or AGI.

evidence_needed: a precommit manifest fixing repository identities, exact commits, license blobs, data-path blobs, parser/schema mapping, normalization rules, minimum key-set coverage, allowed divergence categories, budgets, and zero-upstream-write scope
exact provenance and source-readiness receipts proving both declared files exist and are parseable at the frozen commits before the trial starts
independent normalized key-set digests, coverage and symmetric-difference reports, deterministic sample/query results, and a locally corrupted-input negative control
clean replay from the two exact commits with matching manifest, normalized-output, divergence, and final-result digests
expected_outputs: one immutable selector and protocol manifest for exactly two public country-code datasets
per-source provenance, license, exact-blob, schema, parse, and normalization receipts
a bounded reconciliation report with source counts, normalized alpha-2 key sets, overlap coverage, classified divergences, deterministic queries, and corruption-control detection
a replay verification receipt and a PASS, FAIL, or NOT_EVALUABLE bounded verdict that keeps upper-objective, user-level, production, and AGI claims separately false
failure_conditions: either source, permissive license, declared path, or required identifier field is absent at the frozen commit
repository identity, commit, path, schema mapping, coverage threshold, divergence rules, or queries change after precommit
coverage falls below the frozen threshold, an observed divergence is silently discarded, or query outputs disagree without a bounded attribution
the corrupted-input control is accepted, replay diverges, evidence cannot be exactly attributed, an upstream write occurs, or the bounded result is widened into AGI or user completion
result.goal: Run one precommitted cross-source public-data reconciliation trial over two independently maintained, permissively licensed ISO-country datasets. Freeze both repositories, exact commits, source paths, schema mapping, coverage threshold, divergence rules, and corruption checks before reading record values; then normalize and compare the sources deterministically without modifying either upstream.
inputs: revision131 frozen Root context and the completed UNCERTAIN / NOT_EVALUABLE repair-transfer lifecycle
two independently maintained public repositories with permissive licenses and immutable exact commits exposing ISO alpha-2 country identifiers in different source schemas or encodings
a source-readiness preflight that exact-reads license and declared data paths before final selector freeze without reading target record values
an isolated deterministic Python normalizer with no network access after exact source acquisition
result.parent_continuation: After Execute, independently Task Evaluate the frozen selector, source readiness, provenance, schemas, normalization, overlap coverage, divergence attribution, negative control, replay, and zero-upstream-write evidence. Then continue Candidate, Consolidate Episode, Learn, and Root through protected exact-head publication while AGI and user completion remain false.
result.scope: Read-only public GitHub repository metadata and exact-commit text data, isolated temporary checkouts, and O evidence artifacts for exactly two independently maintained country-code datasets. No upstream write, issue comment, fork mutation, credential use, deployment, Candidate activation, provider or production route change, or AGI/completion claim.
success_conditions: both exact sources pass the frozen license, path, parse, and ISO alpha-2 source-readiness checks without selector substitution
the normalized key-set overlap meets the precommitted coverage threshold and every symmetric difference is explicitly attributed from frozen evidence
all precommitted deterministic queries reproduce from both normalized sources where the relevant keys overlap
the negative-control mutation is detected, clean replay reproduces all content digests, and no upstream write occurs
